t: The Milwaukee Glass and Tile Drill Bits 5 Piece Set provides professional-grade drilling for non-toughened glass, soft to medium-hard tiles, and ceramics. This essential kit is ideal for plumbers, tilers, and general builders undertaking bathroom and kitchen installations. Featuring sharpened carbide tips, these drill bits deliver fast cutting speeds. A reinforced carbide head ensures exceptional durability and extended bit life. Easy identification is provided by the red painted tip, and the multi-flat shank design, from 5mm diameter, prevents chuck slippage. Supplied with PACKOUT-compatible case.
b: Red Painted Tip for Quick Identification
